title: Gestures
description: Touchpad and touchscreen swipes between workspaces

options.label: Swipe distance
options.description: How far you need to swipe to change workspace

options.label: Invert touchpad direction
options.description: Reverse the swipe direction on the touchpad

options.label: Swipe from touchscreen edge
options.description: Switch workspaces by swiping from the edge of a touchscreen

options.label: Invert touchscreen direction
options.description: Reverse the swipe direction on the touchscreen

options.label: Cancel threshold
options.description: How much of the swipe must be done to complete the switch. Lower means easier

options.label: Create new workspace
options.description: Swiping past the last workspace creates a new one

options.label: Swipe without limit
options.description: Do not stop at neighbouring workspaces while swiping

options.label: Lock swipe direction
options.description: Lock the swipe axis once you pass the threshold

options.label: Direction lock threshold
options.description: Distance to swipe before the direction locks

options.label: Quick swipe speed
options.description: Swipe speed that forces the switch regardless of distance

options.label: Use relative workspaces
options.description: Swipe through existing workspaces only, using relative numbering

options.label: Close gesture timeout
options.description: Maximum time a close gesture may take

options.label: Snap to column grid
options.description: Snap windows to the column grid when you release a scrolling-layout move gesture

options.label: Move cursor with snap
options.description: Also move the cursor when the scrolling gesture snaps
